scope: Non-decision logging and read-only daily session evidence; no runtime or host changes

design.formatter: Real YAML uses JSONFormatter with record.created UTC and JSON escaping. Diagnostic nonfinite extras are strings.
design.stream: logs/sessions/YYYY-MM-DD.jsonl; intra_session_log_v1; append by record UTC date; restart appends; no rotation or pruning.
design.collection: New collections pin log_contract and exactly one daily filename. No fallback to legacy rotations. No-follow stable reads and whole-capture signatures retained.
design.quality: Missing, rotated, malformed, unversioned, wrong-day, naive-time, invalid UTF-8, nonstandard numeric JSON, truncated or gapped streams cannot qualify.
design.legacy: Older immutable packs without log_contract retain original parsing and verdicts; historical bytes untouched.
design.boundary: New handler creates canonical stream; missing beginning of session still blocks coverage. Original120second freshness and tick-gap thresholds unchanged.
design.context_policy: Deployed YAML omits plain LogRecord extras and exception text/traceback; retains exception type. Canonical formatter defaults to same omission. Existing other JSONFormatter callers retain prior default behavior. Existing message/structlog text still relies on caller scrubbing.
design.strict_json: Canonical parser rejects duplicate fields, nonfinite constants/overflow and nesting deeper than32 with an explicit iterative portable bound; splits only physical LF. Producer preserves nonfinite/overflow diagnostic values as strings; Unicode separators remain inside single records.

validation.environment: Clean env, no pytest autoload, explicit asyncio+timeout, no cache, sandbox deny network*, timeout30.
validation.suites: new logging contract; daily; host; standdown; adjacent logging; settings; config coordinator; system integration
validation.freeze: PASS with pinned nonsecret env; active cutoff unchanged
validation.initial_empty_env_freeze: Rejected six missing approved env values only; supplied values for correct verification without changing source/freeze.

runtime_behavior_changed: Prospective logging only; no decisions, models, params, feed, cutoff, accounting or API changes
risks_and_limits: No actual-host installation or logging acceptance claimed.
Monday remains blocked; no historical day is requalified.
Daily logs retained indefinitely; pruning requires a separately reviewed operational policy.
Malformed canonical records withhold coverage even if unrelated to a decision.
Full safety/replay/artifact pack, review and PR remain parent-owned release gates.
review_repairs: real-YAML plain synthetic-secret extra/exception omission test
actual Unicode U+0085/U+2028/U+2029 through YAML and collector
Explicit depth32 guard with otherwise-valid portable64-level record regression; independent of decoder recursion limits
